The token jumped as much as 2% on Sunday night after President Trump announced "Project Freedom," an initiative designed to provide safe passage for neutral international ships currently trapped in the Strait of Hormuz due to the US-Iran war.

What else you need to know: Bitcoin jumped 12% in April, its strongest monthly gain since May of last year.

# Bitcoin briefly tops $80,000, the highest level since January

Ines Ferré

Ines Ferré  · Senior Business Reporter

1 min read

 BTC-USD
 GC=F

What happened: Bitcoin (BTC-USD) jumped overnight, briefly topping $80,000, its highest level since late January.

What's behind the move: The world's largest cryptocurrency came off January highs as traders digested the latest developments on the war in the Middle East.
